mentions.name: Natural language contact intelligence layer
mentions.description: A natural language intelligence layer for contacts that lets users query their network in plain language (e.g., 'Pull everyone I know who works at a Series A healthtech in the Bay Area who also went to Stanford for undergrad') and returns either structured or unstructured results. Supports large-scale data, automatically enriches contacts with up-to-date data, delivers fast and accurate results, and integrates natively with Gmail and Google Calendar.
mentions.audience: Looking to pilot for free with small qualified teams (early-stage startups with real/immediate need).
